_about: Speakers of each FHB language worldwide — first AND second language (Kevin 2026-10-13: 'number of speakers/users of each language worldwide. People can have more than one edition.'). Figures: projects/fhb-nt-only-research/raw.json, gathered 2026-09-21 from published speaker totals (estimates dated 2019-2023). Totals are a plain sum, so a person who speaks two of our languages is counted in both; the sum may pass world population, and once it does the page says the world is covered rather than quoting a larger number. rosterTotal is the same sum over the full 80-language roster. WORLD is world population: 8.30 billion at 1 July 2026, UN World Population Prospects 2024 revision.
